name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Your upcoming events with the current one marked, and a meeting about to start at the top of the panel, one key to join the call. Add events with a form or one typed line like `standup tomorrow 10:00`.
author: pal

settings.label: Source
settings.description: Where the events come from. Auto is Google once an account is listed below, else the system calendar (EventKit on macOS, khal on Linux).

settings.label: Google accounts
settings.description: One per line as `name = command`: the command prints an access token for the Calendar API (a bare token, or the JSON of an OAuth endpoint with access_token and expires_in). The command owns the secret; pal keeps the token in memory until it expires. In the config file an entry may be a table { name, token_command, calendars } to read calendars other than the primary.

settings.label: Calendars
settings.description: Calendar names (or ids) to show; empty shows every calendar. The filter dropdown narrows further.

settings.label: Days ahead
settings.description: How many days from today My Schedule lists.

settings.label: Bar horizon
settings.description: The bar item shows the next event only when it starts within this many hours; nothing sooner, no item.

settings.label: Skip all-day events on the bar
settings.text: The bar item speaks for timed events only

settings.label: Call row from
settings.description: An event with a call gets a Join row at the top of pal this many minutes before it starts, until ten minutes in.

settings.label: Quick Add length
settings.description: How long an event typed without an end or a `for` lasts.

store.tagline: Today at a glance, one key to join the call
features: Today and My Schedule: events in order, each tagged `in 12 min`, `now` or `over`
`enter` joins the Zoom, Meet, Teams or Webex call, or opens the event
A call about to start sits at the top of the panel before you type anything
The next event on the menu bar, amber inside 15 minutes and red inside 5; a click joins
Add events by form or one line (`dentist fri 2pm-3pm`); delete one after a confirmation
Reads Calendar.app's accounts on macOS, `khal` on Linux, or Google Calendar directly

actions.title: Join call
actions.description: Opens the meeting link; first when the event has one.

actions.title: Open in Calendar
actions.description: Shows the event in Calendar.app (macOS), or opens it in Google Calendar for a Google account.

actions.title: Copy event details
actions.description: Title, when, where and the link as text.

actions.title: Delete event
actions.description: Asks first; on a repeating event only this occurrence goes (macOS).

actions.title: New event
actions.description: The form, then the event in the chosen calendar.

actions.title: Add event
actions.description: Quick Add: the line as typed becomes the event.

actions.title: Grant access
actions.description: On the permission row: the system prompt, or System Settings when it was denied.

schedule.title: My Schedule
schedule.description: The next days' events in time order, sectioned by day, the current or next one tagged; a New event row at the end (system calendar).

keys.title: Join the call, else open in Calendar

today.title: Today
today.description: The day's events in order with the time, how long, and where each stands (`in 12 min`, `now, 25 min left`, `over`); tomorrow's once today is done; what the bar item opens. At the root, a Join row for a call from a few minutes before it starts until ten minutes in.

keys.title: Join the call, else open in Calendar
Details: the description, the attendees with their replies, the link

quick.title: Quick Add Event
quick.description: One line into an event: a title, then a day (`tomorrow`, `fri`, `next tue`, `20 sep`, `2026-09-20`), a time or a range (`10:00`, `2pm-3pm`, `14:00 to 15:30`), `for 45m`, `at <place>`, `@ <calendar>` (or `in <calendar>` when one starts with the word), `all day`. No time: all day; no day: today, or tomorrow once the time has passed. The row shows the event read back as you type; Enter adds it. At the root a query nothing matched gets an Add fallback row.

phase.description: The next event's time state: far, near, warning, critical, running, or none within the horizon

minutes.description: Minutes until the next event starts (negative while it runs)

call.description: The next event has a call to join

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: The next event's name with `in 12m` beside it, `25m left` while it runs (and `in 8m` for the one due next); hidden when nothing starts within the horizon; a dot when there is a call to join. The colour follows the rules: muted far off and near, amber from Warning from, red from Critical from, green while it runs. A click joins the call, or opens Calendar; a hover peek opens the day with Join on the calls, the running event on a card, tomorrow folded.

running-next.title: In progress, the next one in 8 minutes

item.title: Project review
item.tooltip: Project review, 10:20 – 10:50 (Work), Enter joins; then Design sync, 11:00 – 11:30 (Team)

keys.title: Join the focused event's call, else open it in Calendar (Google Calendar for a Google account)
Open Calendar (the day's page on calendar.google.com for a Google account)
Copy the focused event's conference link
Move between the rows; a click on a row focuses it, a click on Join joins it

rules.description: Inside Near from, before Warning from.
Inside Critical from: about to start.
Under way: what is left of it.

settings.label: Near from
settings.description: Inside this many minutes, Upcoming uses its near appearance. Warning and critical cutoffs below still take precedence.

settings.label: Warning from
settings.description: The bar item uses its warning appearance this many minutes before the event.

settings.label: Critical from
settings.description: The bar item uses its critical appearance this many minutes before the event.
